blockers.detail: SFT-ENC-01 covers 20 new result families in the reviewed supervised-finetuning export. In each, a final value, verdict, or repaired state is visible before the matching spoken clause ends. Each time below is the earliest matching decoded frame found within that beat; it does not prove the output was absent from every earlier scene. The review records the full spoken clauses and frame samples around their completion. The count excludes a later 0.364 repeat at 592.4 s because that value had already appeared in an earlier beat. At 527.233 s, the frame shows ln(4) ≈ 1.386 and the direct-gradient conclusion; those clauses end at 529.054 s and 533.379 s. The reject/reformat result appears at 544.967 s, before its clause ends at 559.306 s. The first 0.364 mean appears at 582.467 s, before its averaging clause ends at 585.896 s. At 638.400 s, both 0.596 and the response-only mean 2.000 are visible before their clauses end at 642.633 s and 644.658 s. The 96% prompt-term share of scored terms, not parameter gradients, appears at 647.867 s, before its clause ends at 657.712 s. In the packing example, 7.2 appears at 734.000 s before its clause ends at 759.562 s; the perturbed result 67.2 appears at 764.233 s before its clause ends at 772.906 s. The 1.3 token mean appears at 843.067 s, before its clause ends at 851.554 s. At 871.967 s, 128 loader items and 6,240 active targets are visible before their clauses end at 882.604 s and 890.667 s. The later 256-item total appears at 898.867 s before its clause ends at 908.446 s. At 1060.700 s, AdamW’s restored weight 0.873366 and fresh-optimizer weight 1.000 appear together before their clauses end at 1065.905 s and 1070.605 s. At 1089.367 s, the retained-velocity SGD weight 0.52 and reset-velocity weight 0.70 are visible before their clauses end at 1113.264 s and 1116.476 s. The step-600 winner appears at 1287.100 s before the comparison ends at 1292.728 s. At 1506.167 s, the repaired END/USER labels appear before the repair instruction ends at 1510.698 s. The broken mean 1.461 is already visible at 1506.067 s, while its clause continues to 1528.511 s; the repaired mean 0.768 appears at 1528.933 s before its clause ends at 1531.499 s. The SGD terminal weights and broken mean are unconditional once their beats are active; AdamW, the winner, the repaired labels, and the repaired mean use cue-start gates. The final arithmetic is correct, so the defect is reveal timing. These observations concern the archived reviewed export (SHA-256 aceb70bfe524), not proof of the latest candidate or current publication. The 2026-11-08 inventory lists a newer audio-ready candidate whose direction review was unrevisited.

Existing narration,article,quiz and final values can stay fixed; use precise nonspoken result anchors where necessary.
